svg.title: Reshaping the tax curve
svg.desc: A purple S-shaped curve sweeps from left to right, smoothly changing towards a randomly chosen midpoint and steepness at each turn. Its endpoints stay on the bottom and top edges of the frame. Sixty-four previous curves hold their earlier shapes and quickly fade away, progressing through Magma from purple towards magenta and coral as they age. This is an illustration of flexibility, not a numerical tax proposal.
